newsitem.title: USA: United Stationers names Larrimore CEO.
newsitem.headline: United Stationers names Larrimore CEO.

text.p: United Stationers Inc said Tuesday its board had elected Randall Larrimore of padlock maker MasterBrand Industries Inc as president and chief executive, succeeding Frederick Hegi Jr.
Hegi, who had served as chairman, interim president and chief executive since last November, will remain chairman, United Stationers said.
Larrimore has been president and chief executive of MasterBrand, a unit of American Brands Inc, since 1988, United Stationers said.
Under Larrimore's leadership, sales at MasterBrand grew to $1.4 billion in 1996 from $437 million in 1988, it said.
Larrimore also was named a director of United Stationers.
United Stationers is a whoesaler of business products to resellers. It had sales of $2.3 billion in 1996.
